topics.title: Howard Orders Funeral Reef for Zookeeper
topics.summary: During a morning drive broadcast, Howard Stern and his team order a large funeral wreath – with the message "Rest in Peace, You Jackass" – to be sent to WJFK’s zookeeper after announcing listener numbers have increased by 100,000. The call center attempts to take the order while fielding bizarre questions about the recipient's identity and personal details.

topics.title: Stern Show Debate Over Inappropriate Wreath Messaging
topics.summary: During a broadcast, Howard Stern and his team engaged in a heated debate over inappropriate messages for a flower wreath intended as a gift to John DeBella of WMMR radio. Suggestions included ‘rot in peace’ and ‘eat it, you peckerhead,’ leading to discussions about the recipient's identity and ultimately deciding on signing off with the show’s name.”

topics.title: Tom Chiazzano’s Empire State Antenna Negotiations
topics.summary: Radio executive Tom Chiazzano secured a new management role representing radio station managers, including negotiating antenna space for K-Rock on the Empire State Building. His colleagues expressed confusion and speculation regarding his decisions, bathroom habits, and theories about flight 52 while discussing various unrelated topics like restroom usage and conspiracy theories.

topics.title: Hollywood Confessions and Sexual Encounters
topics.summary: A former porn star, Paul Beresi, recounts a two-year affair with John Travolta involving multiple women including Olivia Newton-John and Deborah Winger. The conversation details awkward encounters at the Lambert Josh Hotel, fantasies, and attempts to impress Travolta through suggestive behavior like showering while looking for him.

topics.title: Stallone, Travolta & Baresi - Brentwood Chaos
topics.summary: During a chaotic gathering at Sylvester Stallone’s home in Brentwood, John Travolta and producer Tom Baresi engaged in bizarre conversations about their pursuits. The conversation devolved into tangents involving physical descriptions, personal anxieties regarding sex, computer fixation, and an odd fascination with Rambo, ultimately culminating in a confused exchange about mailing lists and a strange phone call.

topics.title: Tech Troubles and Madonna’s Controversy
topics.summary: The host discusses difficulties notifying people about his work, referencing computer use and criticizes singer Madonna for her behavior and musical influence while highlighting an interview with a dentist involved in a legal dispute. He also expresses skepticism regarding the impact of computers on business and makes comments about Madonna's public image.
